sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_trade_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
) 
SELECT 
    f.trade_date, 
    f.fii_net_today, 
    f.dii_net_today, 
    r.regime, 
    b.ad_signal, 
    i.trend_signal
FROM 
    signals.fii_dii_flows f
JOIN 
    signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date 
JOIN 
    breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN 
    market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date AND i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
WHERE 
    f.trade_date = (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_trade_date);
sql_templates.template_description: Retrieve today's FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index to assess market context.
